open_points.subject: import_snapshot timestamps for ApprovedEstimateSnapshot
open_points.text: - import_snapshot: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
open_points.other_text: - _build_approved_snapshot: [PROVENANCE] MUST copy publication identity/content, actor service principal and key_version, fingerprint, and received_at into a new immutable snapshot without Registry name/address fields.
open_points.question: Must “every timestamp it writes” exclude publication-supplied approved_at and published_at, or must the provenance requirement stop copying those timestamps?
